display_name: 同记录三视图源恢复误差一致性
description: 测量同一源记录三个合法模拟视图的 DURA 误差交叉项及三视图平均源 IQ 误差。
authorization: User authorizes ongoing Phase1 F-free restoration research, source-only diagnostics and GPU use.

code.environment: Local RTX 5070 Ti GPU0 FP32 TF32off, fixed source context

data.dataset: Phase1 Main split permitted source L_s/U_s
data.representation: 32768 source fit IDs x three aligned simulated source received/DURA/clean IQ views
data.contract_ref: docs/PROJECT_PROTOCOL.md: 恢复器主测试口径及源数据权限
data.physical_ids_ref: One ordered 32768-source-ID cache, corresponding three views verified by identical clean tensors
data.validation_ref: Existing fixed source fit data, no independent or target sample

permissions.claim_scope: Source IQ error consistency and a nondeployable three-view reference only; not identity accuracy or a general bound

checkpoint.initialization: Fixed source-only DURA context cache; no model updates
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Fixed DURA source-only context, 32768 distinct source IDs, three matching clean IQ views, no F/TX/V/target
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Frozen DURA source context, no target ancestry
checkpoint.selection_rule: All fixed source records; no checkpoint selection

execution.stop_rule: Stop on source contract mismatch, view misalignment or nonfinite calculation

expected_artifacts: result.json: source view and three-view average IQ errors and signed error cross terms

dimensions: all and four source observed-noise quartiles

rows.method: Paired fixed DURA source-view error decomposition and three-view average
rows.purpose: Assess whether single-view source recovery errors share bias or can be reduced by source-only multiview teacher construction
rows.seed_notes: Fixed original source fit IDs and three existing views; no new randomness or model training
rows.scenario: 64 fixed source training IDs, three source simulation views
rows.budget_ref: 32768 fixed source records x three views; no target query or model updates
expected_artifacts: result.json: source view and three-view average IQ errors and signed error cross terms

notes: The three source views are matched by physical ID and verified to have identical clean IQ; no assumed statistical independence.
Averaging multiple views is diagnostic only; Phase1 target inference has one observation.
No F, TX labels, V or target data; IQ error does not establish identity recognition performance.
